codeReview.summary: Solid implementation of the knowledge library module. All 4 exported functions (initLibrary, readLibraryTopic, writeLibraryTopic, appendLibraryTopic) correctly implement the specified behavior. Topic name validation uses a strict regex that properly rejects path traversal and special characters. Truncation logic is correct — content exceeding 2000 chars is sliced to make room for the '...truncated' marker, keeping total output at exactly 2000 chars. The module is well-structured with clear separation: validation, path helpers, truncation, and CRUD functions. Tests are comprehensive with 28 tests covering all validation contract assertions plus boundary cases. The initLibrary call is correctly wired into mission init at index.ts:928.

issues.description: The topicPath helper function is defined but only used by readLibraryTopic. writeLibraryTopic (line 63) and appendLibraryTopic (line 72) compute the file path inline using join(dir, `${topic}.md`). Minor inconsistency — should either use topicPath everywhere or remove it.
rmSync is imported from node:fs but never used in the test file. Unused import.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker followed TDD procedure correctly: wrote 28 failing tests first, then implemented, then verified full suite + typecheck + lint. This matches the AGENTS.md and skill procedure exactly.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript skeleton shows test creation before implementation, followed by bun test, npx tsc --noEmit, and biome check.
